name: Python Fundamentals
description: Core Python syntax, data types, control flow, functions, modules, comprehensions and idiomatic error handling.

name: Git & Version Control
description: Commits, branches, merging, rebasing, remotes and collaborative workflows with pull requests.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Arrays, hash maps, stacks, queues, trees and graphs; searching, sorting, recursion and Big-O complexity analysis.

name: Software Testing
description: Unit and integration tests, pytest fixtures, mocking, coverage and property-based testing.

name: SQL Fundamentals
description: SELECT queries, filtering, joins, aggregation with GROUP BY and HAVING, and NULL semantics in relational databases.

name: Advanced SQL & Query Tuning
description: Common table expressions, window functions, ranking, indexing strategy and reading EXPLAIN query plans.

name: Relational Database Design
description: Keys, constraints, normalization, modelling relationships, transactions and isolation levels.

name: Statistics Foundations
description: Descriptive statistics, distributions, sampling, confidence intervals and hypothesis testing.

name: Probability
description: Random variables, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, expectation and common probability distributions.

name: Linear Algebra for ML
description: Vectors, matrices, matrix multiplication, rank, inverses, eigenvectors and the geometry behind PCA.

name: Data Wrangling with pandas
description: DataFrames, indexing with loc and iloc, groupby aggregation, joins, reshaping and vectorized operations.

name: Data Visualization
description: Choosing chart types, perceptual principles, color scales, and plotting with matplotlib and seaborn.

name: Exploratory Data Analysis
description: Profiling datasets, missing data mechanisms, outliers, correlation versus causation and subgroup analysis.

name: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Supervised learning, regression and classification, bias-variance tradeoff, regularization and scikit-learn workflows.

name: Model Evaluation & Validation
description: Train/test splits, cross-validation, precision, recall, ROC AUC, calibration and avoiding data leakage.

name: Feature Engineering
description: Encoding categorical variables, scaling, feature selection, target leakage and target encoding.

name: Deep Learning
description: Neural networks, backpropagation, optimization, regularization, convolutional networks and PyTorch.

name: NLP Fundamentals
description: Tokenization, TF-IDF, word embeddings, attention and Transformer language models.

name: Docker & Containers
description: Images, containers, Dockerfiles, layer caching, volumes, multi-stage builds and container security.

name: MLOps & Model Deployment
description: Model versioning, serving, monitoring for data drift, training-serving skew and safe rollout strategies.

name: HTML & CSS
description: Semantic HTML, accessibility, the CSS box model, specificity, flexbox and grid layout.

name: JavaScript
description: Values and types, functions and closures, objects, the event loop, promises and async/await.

name: TypeScript
description: Static types, unions, generics, narrowing, utility types and typing real-world JavaScript code.

name: React
description: Components, props, state, hooks, effects, rendering behaviour and building interactive user interfaces.

name: HTTP & REST APIs
description: HTTP methods, status codes, headers, idempotency, CORS, authentication and REST API design.

name: Backend APIs with FastAPI
description: Building validated Python web APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic, dependency injection, auth and configuration.
